scenario.description: MODIS-scale series: real Aqua before the shutdown month, emulated Aqua from VIIRS S-NPP from it on. The harmonized series does not change, because since 2012 it is n_viirs / p_viirs with p_viirs calibrated once on 2013-2020; only S-NPP outage days filled with Aqua (modis_filled) depend on MODIS.

method.aqua_observed: Aqua MODIS cell-days on days when Aqua and S-NPP were both available (same days as the emulator), so it can differ from series.json modis_equiv in months with outages.
method.aqua_emulated: Sum over S-NPP cell-days of the gradient-boosting probability that Aqua also sees the cell-day, plus the calibration-period rate of Aqua-only cell-days per S-NPP cell-day (region x month). Trained on 2013-2020.
method.aqua_emulated_range: 90% range from 500 replicates: normal approximation of the Bernoulli sum, Poisson residual count, times a structural factor resampled from the monthly log(observed/emulated) of the same region in 2013-2022 (months with at least 20 Aqua cell-days and full coverage), leaving out the month's own year. Pool sizes: {'amazonia': 104, 'costa': 83, 'sierra': 81, 'peru': 114}.
method.harmonized: estimated, est_low and est_high of series.json.
method.harmonized_viirs_only: Capture-recapture segments that use VIIRS only (n_snpp / p_viirs, and NOAA-20 scaled to S-NPP after the end of S-NPP). Its range equals the series range when no day is filled with MODIS; otherwise it is the sum of segment ranges.
method.modis_filled: Part of harmonized that comes from S-NPP outage days filled with Aqua; harmonized = harmonized_viirs_only + modis_filled.
method.drift: From 2023 the Aqua orbit drifts to a later overpass, so Aqua sees less than the emulator expects; aqua_vs_emulated_pct measures that gap.
